prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1231; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of impact, and the presenting symptoms align well with that mechanism. Physical examination revealed reduced abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain involving the same region, which resolved completely without residual limitation and did not require further care. Treatment over six visits consisted of physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and anti-inflammatory medication, and followed a typical course. Symptoms and function improved steadily, and visit frequency was tapered accordingly as the patient progressed. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without duplicate charges. Discharge is anticipated once the patient reaches full functional goals, with follow-up as needed.
